preconditions: Non-production tenant or isolated local fixture; synthetic records only; Include one malformed record and verify quarantine or clear failure without silent loss. Safety boundary: Use disposable synthetic repositories and mock integrations only. Never expose real credentials, modify production repositories, or publish/merge changes during a test run.
test_steps: 1. Create a disposable, versioned synthetic fixture: Include one malformed record and verify quarantine or clear failure without silent loss. 2. Execute the platform workflow to audit pause, resume, interruption, and cleanup. 3. Capture the committed result, resource version, or run status. 4. Compare the result with the source fixture and the declared invariant. 5. Repeat or recover the operation when applicable; verify access, audit evidence, and side effects.
expected_result: The platform must correctly audit pause, resume, interruption, and cleanup; the corrupt input condition follows the configured contract; valid state is preserved, invalid or unauthorized work is rejected or quarantined without silent loss, retries do not duplicate side effects, lineage and audit evidence remain available, and no production records or credentials are used. Safety boundary: Use disposable synthetic repositories and mock integrations only. Never expose real credentials, modify production repositories, or publish/merge changes during a test run.
